amenityHighlights: Lincoln Center Stage live classical music

cabinCategories.description: Holland America's elegantly appointed interior stateroom with signature Mariner's Dream bed and premium bath amenities.
Spacious ocean-view stateroom with large picture window. Perfect for watching Alaska's stunning coastline on scenic cruising days.
Private verandah stateroom — essential for Glacier Bay day when the scenery demands an outdoor front-row seat.
Signature Suite with separate living area, Nespresso machine, priority disembarkation, and exclusive Neptune Lounge access.

inclusions: All meals in main dining room and Lido Market

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Holland America's Eurodam begins its elegant 7-night Glacier Bay voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital city — flanked by mountains and the Gastineau Channel. Visit Mendenhall Glacier, whale watch in Auke Bay, or tour the Alaska State Museum.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: A full day of awe-inspiring scenic cruising through Glacier Bay. A National Park Ranger boards to narrate the remarkable glacial landscape.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Once the capital of Russian Alaska, Sitka blends Tlingit Native culture with Russian heritage. Visit St. Michael's Cathedral and the Sitka National Historical Park.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: The colorful Creek Street historic district, world-class totem pole parks, and fresh-caught Dungeness crab define this beloved Alaska port.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: A beautiful day of scenic sailing through the protected waters of the Inside Passage — watch for humpback whales, orcas, and bald eagles.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

reviewSnippet: Holland America's mid-size, classic-style ship with ranger-narrated Glacier Bay scenic cruising and nightly live music — a relaxed, refined choice for scenery-focused travelers.
